caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular clutch or pouch with a curved flap at the top, shown in color, positioned centrally on a plain beige background. The main body of the pouch is rendered in a muted red tone and decorated with embroidered floral patterns in shades of blue, green, brown, and gold, with the flowers and leaves distributed diagonally across the surface. The edges of the flap and pouch are bordered with a darker brown band. Above the pouch, there is a semicircular, lightly sketched outline featuring symmetrical, simple floral and scroll motifs, suggesting a possible design for the interior or another view of the flap. Below the pouch, another lightly sketched outline presents a simplified, cone-shaped side view of the item, showing its profile and inner fold lines. The rest of the background remains unadorned, with some faint smudges and creases visible on the paper.
title: Purse
